title: The Linux Terminal and Command-Line Fundamentals
learning_outcomes: Use the terminal confidently, understand command syntax and exit status, and consult local documentation.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
